name: Researcher Phase Transition → SYNTHESIZE
description: ADR-041 Slice 2D-3 forward spawn rule. Fires when phasevalidator.PhaseValidator has approved a gather→synthesize transition and stamped chain.phase_transition.proceed.synthesize="true" on the source researcher-gather loop entity. The validator has checked the edge AND the per-phase cap (max 2 synthesize fires per chain). Same two-step fire shape as 04-phase-transition-to-gather.json.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.researcher-synthesize
on_enter.prompt:
SYNTHESIZE phase entry. Source loop $entity.instance (researcher-gather) has handed off with decide(action="synthesize"). Call read_loop_result on that loop to read the gathered evidence in its narrative terminal. Compose the structured research artifact (actors/integration_points/tasks/addressed_gaps/open_gaps) from the evidence per researcher-synthesize/00-identity.md and 10-emit-rules.md. Use scratchpad to draft before the strict-schema emit_research_artifact call.

Terminal options (allow-list enforced by phasevalidator): decide(action="architect") forward to the architect phase (dev-via-spec arc); decide(action="gather") back-edge if synthesis surfaces a corpus gap (bounded by gather cap=3); decide(action="emit") pure-research-arc terminal (deployments without an architect phase); decide(action="needs_clarification") when evidence is structurally inconsistent with the plan.

metadata.proceed_sentinel: chain.phase_transition.proceed.synthesize on source researcher-gather loop entity
